content_sections.heading: ESIC Contractual Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Contractual Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Contractual Medical Officer positions at ESIC is scheduled for 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to be present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Contractual Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Contractual Medical Officer position, candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. Degree or an equivalent qualification from a university recognized by the relevant authorities.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Contractual Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Contractual Medical Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 75,000 per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Contractual Medical Officer position is 69 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ESIC Contractual Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the specified venue on the interview date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for the ESIC Contractual Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Contractual Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies announced for the Contractual Medical Officer position by the Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Thane, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400604. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any registration date mentioned before the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes, registration dates are mentioned as 24 June 2026 and 25 June 2026 (if necessary). Candidates should refer to the official notification for precise timings and procedures.
